This report validates experimental operations only. Pilot seeds 100–102 are
excluded from every confirmatory hypothesis test and effect estimate.

```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

qc = json.loads(Path("pilot_qc_data.json").read_text())
runs = pd.DataFrame(qc["reports"])
```

## Study matrix completeness

```{python}
pd.Series({key: qc[key] for key in ("expected_runs", "valid_runs", "missing_runs", "invalid_runs", "complete")})
```

## Runtime, failures, and artifact size

```{python}
runs[[column for column in ("run_id", "status", "runtime_seconds", "checkpoint_bytes", "error") if column in runs]]
```

## Reward feasibility and numerical health

```{python}
runs[[column for column in ("run_id", "rewarded_training_episodes", "upright_entries") if column in runs]]
```

The automated validator separately checks finite metrics, positive action
standard deviation, delayed-reward payout timing and discounted conservation,
evaluation cadence, model initialization by seed, and checkpoint presence.
Learning curves and optimizer diagnostics are added only after all runs pass.

## Proposed frozen settings

The freeze decision is recorded in `docs/pilot_decisions.md` after all 24 runs
pass the quality gate. No horizon comparison is interpreted in this report.
